Content inside <noscript> only renders with scripting disabled and must not appear in the output

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>visible</p><noscript><p>secret noscript text</p></noscript><p>also visible</p>')
puts result.content.inspect
```
